description: This Swift source file defines an abstraction for managing user notifications, including an enum for authorization status, a protocol for notification center operations, and a concrete implementation using UserNotifications framework.

classes.name: LiveNotificationCenter
classes.description: Concrete implementation of NotificationCentering protocol using UNUserNotificationCenter.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current notification authorization status from the user notification center.

methods.description: Requests notification authorization with specified options, returning true if granted.
